description: Defines the ProgramTable class for managing MPEG program data, observers, and NIT PIDs within the Thunder::Broadcast namespace.

classes.name: ProgramTable
classes.description: Manages MPEG program information, observers, and NIT PIDs, with singleton access.

classes.name: ProgramTable::Observer
classes.description: Inner class that observes MPEG sections related to a specific program.

methods.name: Instance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of ProgramTable.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Clears the current list of programs.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers an observer callback for a specific keyId.

methods.name: Program
methods.description: Retrieves and compares a program's PMT data for a given keyId and programId.

methods.name: NITPid
methods.description: Returns the NIT PID associated with a keyId.

methods.name: Key
methods.description: Generates a unique key from keyId and programId.

methods.name: AddProgram
methods.description: Adds or updates a program's MPEG::Table data.
